column2: AN ACT TO AMEND THE SAFEGUARD MEASURES
ACT, NO. 3 OF 2018
BE it enacted by the Parliament of the Democratic Socialist
Republic of Sri Lanka as follows: -
1.This  Act  may  be  cited  as  the  Safeguard  Measures

(Amendment) Act, No. 
 of 2024.
2. Section 2 of the Safeguard Measures Act, No. 3 of 2018,
(hereinafter referred to as the “principal enactment”) is hereby
amended  in  subsection  (1)  thereof,  by  the  substitution  for
the words “the Director General of Commerce (hereinafter
referred to as the “Director General”)”, of the words “Secretary
to  the  Ministry  of  the  Minister  assigned  the  subject  of
International  Trade  (hereinafter  referred  to  as  the
“Secretary”),”.
3.  The  principal  enactment  is  hereby  amended  by  the
substitution for the words “Director General” wherever those
words occur in the principal enactment, notice, notification,
contract,  communication  or  other  document,  of  the  words
“Secretary to the Ministry of the Minister assigned the subject
of International Trade”.
